_comment: Local site settings for the comic download stage -- copy this file to
src/comic_site.json and fill in the real site.
This example is tracked; comic_site.json is gitignored, exactly like
scraper_config.json. Keep it that way: the tracked half of the comic's
settings (comic_config.json) must never name a real site.
comic_series_url: the series page for a slug, with {slug} filled in from
--slug (or --name). The chapter list is read from <series>/ajax/chapters/,
so this is the one place the site's URL shape is written down.
comic_site_host: the only host page images may come from, including its
subdomains. The pages inject scripts that redirect to ad hosts, so any
other image URL is refused rather than followed.
The placeholder below (comic-site.test) is a reserved test suffix and is
not a real site. The downloader refuses to run until this is filled in.
Do not use example.com here: the host check accepts subdomains of the
configured host, so it would also accept evil.example.com.
